LanguageData.HulkSettingsTimerSummary: Forced Hulk Revert only applies to emergency rage states and shows a countdown bar. Time Restricted Hulk only applies to manual transforms and shows remaining time on the Hulk hediff.
LanguageData.HulkSettingsSummary: Gamma healing is intentionally aggressive. By default it only runs in Hulk form, though you can opt into all-form healing. It heals open injuries, can strip permanent scars, cure disease-like/chronic conditions such as asthma, regrow missing parts, auto-resurrect into a revenge Hulk, and now includes full combat/ability tuning plus optional transformation timers.
LanguageData.HulkHealingFilterInfo: Checked = Hulk will try to heal, remove, or regrow it. Unchecked = blocked by the filter. Reset restores Hulk's default exclusion list. Nothing here is hard-locked.
